title: Flow Failure
fullDescription: FLO appears on Bullfrog A/M/STIL series spas when heater calls for heat but no flow detected. Common with dirty filter or air lock.

title: Flow Switch Stuck Closed
fullDescription: HFL indicates flow switch is stuck closed. Heater locked.

title: Spa Overheat
fullDescription: OH indicates water above 108F threshold. Allow cool down.

title: Hi-Limit Tripped
fullDescription: HL indicates hi-limit fault. Restore flow first.

title: Temperature Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Sn1 indicates fault on water temperature sensor.

title: Priming Mode
fullDescription: Pr indicates priming mode after fill or power cycle. Press jets to exit.

title: Water Below Setpoint
fullDescription: COOL indicates water more than 20F below setpoint.

title: Freeze Protection
fullDescription: ICE indicates anti-freeze pumping cycle. Informational.

title: Spa Watchdog Lockout
fullDescription: Three dashes (---) indicate the spa software detected an internal fault and locked out. Power cycle.
